notes: HSPH's faculty directory (hsph.harvard.edu/profiles/) is a client-rendered app; the per-department '?hsph_department_taxonomy=NNNN' URL does not actually filter results server-side (confirmed: different taxonomy IDs returned identical mixed-department lists). Read the full unfiltered directory once instead, clicking through all ~45 pages via Playwright, and grouped every person by their own listed department. Only 'Primary Faculty' are recorded as labs here; 'Emeritus Faculty' are in non_lab_people. Not individually listed (per the project's convention for large affiliate lists, see Harvard Government/HDSI): 3 Secondary Faculty, 1 Research Scientists -- these are secondary/adjunct appointments or research-scientist staff whose primary lab/appointment is probably elsewhere or not independently confirmed from this listing.
